# Summary for Advisory Board Fall 2026 Meeting
**Journal of Statistics and Data Science in Sport (JSDSS)**

---

**TO:** JSDSS Advisory Board (Doug Fearing, Mike Lopez, Rebecca Nugent, Emily Taylor)

**FROM:** The Editors of JSDSS (Ben Baumer, Ryan Elmore, Brian Macdonald, Gregory J Matthews, Michael Schuckers)

**DATE:** November 2, 2026

---

## Executive Summary

After nearly two years of exploring alternative avenues to create a rigorous, open-access, reproducible sports data science journal, we officially founded the **Journal of Statistics and Data Science in Sports (JSDSS)** in February 2026. Since then, we have reached an agreement with UNC Charlotte Libraries for publishing and hosting via Open Journal Systems (OJS), secured inclusion on [Project Euclid](https://projecteuclid.org/browse/subject/Statistics-and-Probability). for three years, established the journal's [Aims & Scope](https://journals.charlotte.edu/jsdss/about), recruited a strong [Editorial Board and Advisory Board](https://journals.charlotte.edu/jsdss/about/editorialTeam), and written and published our [founding editorial](https://journals.charlotte.edu/jsdss/article/view/2288).  We officially began accepting submissions on **September 1, 2026**. As of October 26, 2026, we have received 18 manuscript submissions.

---

## Key Accomplishments

### 1. Journal Foundation & Governance
* Established Aims & Scope, Editorial Board, and Advisory Board.
* Drafted and published the initial founding editorial.

### 2. Infrastructure & Publishing Partnerships
* **UNC Charlotte Libraries:** Agreement to host the Open Journal Systems (OJS) platform and updated the website branding.
* **Project Euclid & Duke University Press:** Partnership agreement established to have JSDSS appear with other Statistics and Probability journals. Costs (~$7.5\text{K}$ over three years: 2027, 2028, and 2029) are fully covered by UNC Charlotte startup funds.

### 3. Submissions & Editorial Operations
* **Launch:** Began taking manuscripts on September 1, 2026.
* **Submissions Status (as of October 26, 2026):** 18 submissions total
  * 8 Desk Rejected
  * 4 Sent to Peer Review
  * 6 Pending Desk Review
* **CMSAC Collaboration:** Partnered with the Carnegie Mellon Sports Analytics Conference to offer expedited reviews for winners of their Reproducible Research Contest.

### 4. Review Process Documentation
* Comprehensive [Review Process Documentation](https://github.com/jsds-sports/jsdss-manuscript-template/blob/main/instructions-all.md) compiled and published.
  * [Instructions for Authors](https://github.com/jsds-sports/jsdss-manuscript-template/blob/main/instructions-authors.md)
  * [Instructions for Reviewers](https://github.com/jsds-sports/jsdss-manuscript-template/blob/main/instructions-reviewers.md)
  * [Instructions for Associate Editors](https://github.com/jsds-sports/jsdss-manuscript-template/blob/main/instructions-aes.md)

* Establishing Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) setup and workflow.
* AI policy for submissions and reviews

---

## Discussion Points for Advisory Board

1. **Outreach & Promotion:** Strategies for spreading the word about the journal within the academic and practitioner communities.
2. **Journal Positioning:** Strategic alignment and positioning of JSDSS within the broader sports analytics and data science landscape.
3. **Acceptance Balance:** Managing volume vs. maintaining high editorial and methodological rigor.
4. **Sustainability:** Long-term funding model for Project Euclid hosting beyond the initial three-year startup window (post-2029).
